references.text: Parallel verses that give the same instruction to make fire pans into plates as a covering for the altar, since they were consecrated when they were brought before the Lord.
Explains the purpose of the sign: that no foreigner, who is not of Aaron's line, shall approach to burn incense before the Lord.
Describes the construction of the bronze altar of burnt offering, which provides background for the covering made from the fire pans.
Refers to the bronze used to cover the altar, similar to the material from the fire pans.
Refers to the event with Korah and his followers becoming a sign for the children of Israel.
Uses similar language about signs that remind of the Lord's judgment and sanctuary.
Mentions signs and wonders that God performed for Israel as a warning and reminder.
